criterion.evidence: gt reconciliation: walls 9/9 hit (1f 4/4, 2f 5/5), windows 15/15 hit (1f 7/7, 2f 8/8), 0 missed on both plans, max offset 0.0 m. Envelope 15.00x8.00, both corridor walls, and every per-facade window present. No under-tracing.

0 extra walls / 0 extra windows vs gt on both plans (no_oversplit criterion: extra_vwalls+extra_hwalls=0). Furniture (18 symbols on 1f), dimension ticks, and healed door leaves are all logged in uncaptured, not traced as strokes. The prior sm21 south-band over-segmentation failure mode did NOT recur.

Walls vs windows cleanly separated on both plans (distinct wall/window pens). On elevations wall_fill (2 bands per facade) vs window pen are distinct; the South/West facade doors are logged in uncaptured, NOT emitted as window strokes (verified South_view render: 7 blue windows = 3 F1 + 4 F2, door not drawn blue).

Every gt wall + window matched at 0.0 m offset, which is only possible if the transcribed dimension chains are numerically faithful. Spot-checked overall 15000x8000, F1 height 3000 / F2 3600 / roof 6600, north/south window chains — all match the drawings. The unlabeled ~0.24 m (C_right) and ~0.12 m (C_top) residuals were honestly NOT fabricated (documented in self_check), and the real stroke coords still hit gt exactly.

Per-facade window attribution matches gt exactly (1f N3/S3/E1, 2f N2/S4/E1/W1). Elevations declare the correct facade (South_view labeled 'South elevation') with F1/F2 bands stacked correctly; declaration-level orientation self-consistent. World translation left to J1 per rubric.

Door openings healed into continuous walls and logged in uncaptured (1f 8 healed, 2f 6 healed, South/West elevation doors logged). No real opening wrongly healed shut: window/wall gt counts are complete. Discipline followed (unlike the prior run where uncaptured door logs were empty).

All bands/floors present and correctly placed: 1f = 3 north rooms + corridor + 3 south rooms = 7 regions; 2f = 2 conference + corridor + 4 offices = 7 regions; both match testdata thermal_zones=7. Overlay confirms red reading walls seat exactly on gt gray cell boundaries.

Filled zone plan vs original + gt: Floor 1 = 3 north rooms + corridor + 3 south rooms (7 regions); Floor 2 = 2 conference + corridor + 4 offices (7 regions). No rooms wrongly merged, split, missing, or invented. gt reconciliation: walls 9/9 (interior partitions x=5/10 on 1f, x=3.75/7.5/11.25 on 2f; corridor y=3/5), 0 extra walls, 0.0 m offset. Overlay confirms red correction cells seat exactly on gt gray cells.

Corridor walls at y=3.0 / y=5.0 align exactly across Floor 1 and Floor 2 (both 0.0 m offset vs gt); no ~5 cm jitter class. Envelope 15x8 shared. The cross-floor reconcile in the deterministic core had nothing to fix — reading already gave identical corridor axes both floors.
windows 15/15 land on the correct facade/floor/position vs gt, all centre_delta 0.0 m: 1f N3/S3/E1, 2f N2/S4/E1/W1. Overlay window ticks align with gt facade windows.

Zone regions 7+7 match testdata thermal_zones=7 per floor; window count 15 matches gt (1f 7 + 2f 8). Deterministic zone-count tripwire did not fire (gate① 0 block / 0 flag). No merge/split to adjudicate.

The original building can be redrawn from this corrected geometry with no qualitative error: envelope, both corridors, all interior partitions, and every per-facade window are present and correctly placed against both the originals and gt. gate① correction checks passed clean (coverage/closure/zstack/window-on-wall all pass).
